processRestart: publish and recovery use separate Node processes with clean unmount
beforeAck: unchanged private checkpoint rebound to current seal; later source retained and visible
afterAck: original receipt replay preserves later private edits
recoveryReceiptLoss: persisted recovery intent replay preserves later private edits
laterPrivateChanges: unapplied acknowledgement rejected; edits and artifact retained
repeatedConfirmed: idempotent; no helper acknowledgement or source write
limitations: Host fixture only; not production or Sandbox automatic publication
No object GC, external-writer CAS or multi-file atomicity
